column3: Close to the Hebrew; “answer me” is rendered “hear me.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָסִיד (“godly, loyal”) is rendered “holy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Sheol below” is rendered “the depths of Sheol.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a company of ruthless men” is rendered “a mob of violent men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “long of anger” is rendered “Longsuffering,” and “covenant loyalty and faithfulness” “mercy and truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a sign of goodness” is rendered “a sign for good.”
